/*


f define the curve y^2=f(x) over GF(p,d);
f should be a monic degree 5 polynomial with the Coefficient(f,4)=0.

Main function:
ThreeTorsionPointTorsion  - returns a vector with all posible 3-torsion divisors in the curve y^2=f(x) over F_p^d.

Setup:
GF(p,d);
P<x>:=PolynomialRing(F);
J:=Jacobian(HyperellipticCurve(f));
ThreeTorsionPoint(f);
load "TorsionAAECC.txt";

*/
ThreeTorsionPoint:=function(f)
if Degree(f) ne 5 then print "error" ; end if;
if Coefficient(f,4) ne 0 then print "error"; end if;
R<a0,c0,v1>:=PolynomialRing(F,3);

f3:=Coefficient(f,3);
f2:=Coefficient(f,2);
f1:=Coefficient(f,1);
f0:=Coefficient(f,0);

r3:=-768*f2^2*c0^2*f1-5184*a0^2*f3*f2*c0*f0+1920*a0^4*f3*f2*c0*f1-144*a0^4*f3^3*f2*c0+502848*a0^4*f3*c0^3*f0+26784*a0^6*f3^2*c0*f1+307824*a0^12*f3*f2*c0+4320*a0^2*f3^3*f2*c0^2-79320*a0^6*f3^2*f2*c0^2+2304*c0^3*f1*f2*f3-518976*a0^6*f2^2*c0^3+11520*f3*f2*c0^7+506880*a0^2*c0^7*f1+3840*c0*a0^2*f1^2*f3+384*f1^2*f2*c0-27840*a0^2*c0^4*f1*f2+13824*a0^2*c0^3*f1*f3^2+10368*a0^4*f3*f2*f0+27216*a0^4*f3^2*c0*f0-864*a0^2*f3^3*c0*f1+1070208*a0^4*c0^7*f2-51264*a0^4*c0^2*f1^2-24960*a0^2*c0^8*f2-1208160*a0^12*c0^2*f1-3057408*a0^4*c0^6*f1+5582592*a0^6*c0^5*f1-18144*a0^2*f0*f3^2*c0^2+3323520*a0^10*c0^3*f1+9843120*a0^12*f2*c0^3-16848*a0^10*f3*f0-936*a0^4*f3^3*f1+1249632*a0^8*f3*f2*c0^3-4320*a0^2*f3^4*c0^3+15360*f2^3*a0^4*c0-21384*a0^12*f1*f3-4032*a0^4*c0^3*f1*f2-448416*a0^6*f0*f3*c0^2-5503200*a0^8*c0^4*f1-3840*c0^6*f2^2+18144*a0^8*f2*f0+4364928*a0^4*c0^5*f0-118848*c0*a0^8*f1*f2+211896*a0^4*f3^3*c0^4-960*c0^4*f1^2+11520*a0^2*c0^3*f1^2+22591*a0^24-64*f1^3-22131360*a0^18*c0^3-4800*c0^8*f1-14328*a0^10*f3^2*f2+4157280*a0^20*c0^2-1788480*a0^10*f0*c0^2-458820*a0^22*c0-180243648*a0^14*c0^5-20952*a0^14*f0-734400*a0^2*f0*c0^6+291091680*a0^12*c0^6+216*a0^4*f3^5+2295*a0^8*f3^4-317848320*a0^10*c0^7-576*c0^2*f1^2*f3+26544*a0^12*f2^2+8856*a0^4*f3^4*c0^2+9900*a0^12*f3^3+223746240*a0^8*c0^8+13632*a0^2*f3*f2^2*c0^3-327520*a0^6*f3^3*c0^3+661248*a0^6*c0^3*f1*f3+5660136*a0^8*f3^2*c0^4+166560*c0*a0^10*f1*f3+9600*a0^2*c0^5*f2^2-91866240*a0^6*c0^9-383040*a0^6*f3*f2*c0^4+152928*a0^8*f0*f3*c0-1152*a0^2*f3^2*f2^2*c0+17948736*a0^4*c0^10+238752*a0^14*f1*c0-1209600*a0^2*c0^11+67104*a0^8*f3^2*f2*c0-11664*a0^4*f0^2-52704*a0^2*f3^3*c0^5-67392*c0*a0^4*f1*f0+261792*a0^4*f0*f2*c0^2+9361152*a0^4*f3*c0^8-6881760*a0^6*c0^4*f0+15840*a0^2*f3^2*f2*c0^4+234504*a0^8*f3^3*c0^2-19488*a0^16*f1+336*a0^8*f1^2-41304*a0^18*f2+512*f2^3*c0^3+76638360*a0^16*c0^4+32868*a0^20*f3+51043392*a0^8*f3*c0^6+9504*a0^6*f3*f2*f1+160704*a0^6*c0^2*f1*f2+33369480*a0^12*f3*c0^4-7680*f2^2*a0^4*f1-5376*f2^3*c0^2*a0^2-341760*a0^4*f3*f2*c0^5-349056*a0^2*f3^2* p1:=-3*a0^2*v1^2-a0^2*f2-12*a0^5*v1+10*a0^2*c0^3+45*a0^6*c0-60*a0^4*c0^2-a0^4*f3-9*a0^8+3*a0^2*f3*c0+30*a0^3*c0*v1;
p2:=-f1-9*a0^2*v1^2-a0^2*f2-21*a0^5*v1+60*a0^2*c0^3+60*a0^6*c0-105*a0^4*c0^2-3*a0^4*f3-11*a0^8+8*a0^2*f3*c0+60*a0^3*c0*v1-30*a0*c0^2*v1-5*c0^4-3*f3*a0*v1-3*f3*c0^2+2*f2*c0;
p3:=16*f2*a0^2*c0-8*f2*a0*v1-8*a0^2*c0^2*f3-40*a0*c0^3*v1+24*c0*a0^2*v1^2+36*c0*a0^5*v1-120*a0^3*c0^2*v1+12*c0*v1*a0*f3+4*a0^3*v1*f3-8*c0*a0^4*f3+12*a0^4*v1^2+12*a0^7*v1-24*c0*a0^8+140*a0^2*c0^4-40*a0^4*c0^3+6*a0^6*f3+a0^2*f3^2+4*f2*c0^2-8*f2*a0^4+9*a0^10-16*c0^5+8*v1^3*a0-8*f3*c0^3-4*f0;


RT:=Roots(UnivariatePolynomial(T));

counter:=0;
V:=[J!0:i in [1..#RT]];

for i:=1 to #RT do
A0:=RT[i][1];
T1a:=Evaluate(r1,a0,A0);
T2a:=Evaluate(r2,a0,A0);
T3a:=Evaluate(r3,a0,A0);


RC:=Roots(UnivariatePolynomial(GCD(GCD(T1a,T2a),T3a)));
for j:=1 to #RC do
C0:=RC[j][1];
E2a:=Evaluate(p1,a0,A0);
E3a:=Evaluate(p2,a0,A0);
E4a:=Evaluate(p3,a0,A0);
E2b:=Evaluate(E2a,c0,C0);
E3b:=Evaluate(E3a,c0,C0);
E4b:=Evaluate(E4a,c0,C0);
RA:=Roots(UnivariatePolynomial(GCD(GCD(E2b,E3b),E4b)));
for l:=1 to #RA do
V1:=RA[l][1];







V0:=-5*A0*C0^2+10*C0*A0^3+C0*V1-(7/2)*A0^5-3*A0^2*V1-(1/2)*A0*f3;

U1:=2*C0-A0^2; 

U0:=4*A0^2*C0-2*A0^4-2*A0*V1+C0^2;





V[i]:= J![x^2+U1*x+U0,V1*x+V0];
counter:=counter+1;

end for;
end for;
end for;


print counter ;
return V;
end function;
